name: Chala Hawa Yeu Dya Comedycha Gangwar
original_name: Chala Hawa Yeu Dya Comedycha Gangwar
overview: Chala Hawa Yeu Dya - Comedycha Gangwar is a refreshed, competitive format of the popular Marathi comedy show Chala Hawa Yeu Dya, which premiered on July 26, 2025, on Zee Marathi. Unlike the original talk-show format, this season features a "gang war" where legendary mentors lead and train new comic talents in a high-energy competition.
